user.what: Shows only the entries of one panel user; for login attempts, the username that was tried.
user.who: Anyone reviewing what a particular account did, for example after a change nobody remembers making.
user.effect: Filters only the entries already loaded in this browser; load older entries to look further back. Nothing changes on the server.

kind.what: Shows only one kind of action: logins, networks, devices (and device groups), firewall (including VPN rules and Fail2Ban), users, the server (including backups) or other actions (limit profiles, notifications and unrecognised requests).
kind.who: Anyone looking for a certain change, for example who opened a port or deleted a device.
kind.effect: Filters only the entries already loaded in this browser. Nothing changes on the server.

search.what: Finds entries whose sentence, user, IP address, recorded action or path contain all the words you type.
search.who: Anyone looking for a name (a network, a device, a rule), an IP address or a path.
search.effect: Case is ignored. Only the entries already loaded are searched; load older entries to search further back. Nothing changes on the server.
